title: Reporting Live from JPM 2026: Alex Philippidis and Jonathan Grinstein, PhD
summary: In this video our editors took a break from interviewing CEOs, attending corporate presentations, and walking up San Francisco’s famed hills to share some insights about their week at the event—and more broadly, where biopharma now stands and is expected to go in 2026.The postReporting Live from JPM 2026: Alex Philippidis and Jonathan Grinstein, PhDappeared first onGEN - Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology News.
